goal: Test preexisting fixed160, fixed240, adaptive and conservative cost-aware evidence policies under changed consequences and out-of-distribution signal/noise conditions, without retuning classification margins.

scenarios.name: heavy_tailed
scenarios.noise: uniform ±0.23 plus rare ±2.5 impulse at 3% per sample

evaluation: Run all four policies over 320 frozen synthetic streams; compute full confusion and unresolved counts, observations, loss for all four cost tables. Policies not changed after outcomes observed.
limits: Thresholds were tuned on baseline distribution in prior experiment
No inference about training lineage or proof correctness
